placements.title: Transitioning Sprint Retrospectives to the Velociraptor Format
placements.frame: How does adopting the Velociraptor format structure sprint retrospectives around Sailed, Stalled, and Capsized feedback?
placements.why: The team has transitioned its sprint retrospective cadence from the legacy start-stop-continue format to the three-section Velociraptor framework (Sailed, Stalled, and Capsized) to drive iterative team reflection.
